{{Quote|This is Jedi shuttle 634, calling on all secure channels for help. Do you read?|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Ghosts of Mortis" />}}
'''Jedi shuttle 634''' was an [[Eta-class shuttle/Legends|''Eta''-class shuttle]] and served as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ambassadorial [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was flown by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], as well as [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]].

==History==
When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] picked up a 2,000 year old [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] sent [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] along with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to [[Mission to Mortis/Legends|investigate]] this mystery on this ship.

===Mission to Mortis===
Fearing that it may be a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] trap, the three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were to meet up with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] in a heavily armed [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|cruiser]]. Both groups were at the rendezvous point but weren't able to see each other. Captain Rex confirmed that they were indeed in the same location. Then the shuttle was suddenly pulled into a [[Mortis monolith/Legends|monolith]] which caused the three Jedi to black out.

Once the three woke up, the shuttle was safely on the ground of a mysterious planet known as [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]] that was strong with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The three were then approached by [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]] who attempted to bring them to [[Father (Mortis)/Legends|Father]] but were separated into groups after a rockslide. Obi-Wan and Ahsoka decided to head back to this shuttle but was mysteriously gone and were approached by [[Son/Legends|Son]].

After finishing the test the Jedi attempted to leave the planet onboard this shuttle with the permission of Father but were infiltrated by Son who kidnapped Ahsoka causing Kenobi and Skywalker to go back for her. This shuttle then crashed in a field near the [[Son's cathedral/Legends|tower]] where Ahsoka was taken.

After freeing Ahsoka from the tower she offered to fix this shuttle but was unable to fix the heavily damaged ship. Once the harsh battle that took the lives of Daughter, Son, and Father ended, the crystal above the monastery fell and hit the tip of the tower causing it to shatter, making the three black out again. When they awoke they found themselves in space inside this shuttle and were contacted by Rex. The three were confused to learn that it had been only moments since they had lost contact.
